total_model.summary: Model projects 50.4 total points (SF 31, LV 20). Biggest factors: Combined quarterback ratings (raises total 2.5), Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (raises total 1.8), Combined pass defense EPA allowed/play (raises total 1.0). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
